how_to_apply: Fill the application form in MS Word format as per the proforma provided with the advertisement, and take a printout.
Scan the filled application (with photograph and signature) in PDF format.
Submit the application online through the Google Form link: https://forms.gle/LsRQWpksNKC7DxdQ8, latest by 13.10.2026.

Upload the following documents via the Google Form: filled application (PDF/Word), filled "Brief of the Candidate" (Annexure-A, in PDF), filled PowerPoint Presentation (Annexure-B, in MS PowerPoint format), scanned original educational certificates (SSLC to PG, and Ph.D. for non-medical posts), scanned original experience certificates, scanned copies of other relevant documents, and scanned copies of the latest original UG & PG registration certificates.

Separately, send the duly signed hard-copy application form along with Annexure-A and self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents (age, educational qualification, experience, category, etc.) by Speed/Registered Post to: Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur, Administrative Block, Kunraghat, Gorakhpur – 273008, so as to reach by 13.10.2026.
Superscribe the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ……………………… (mention name of the post applied for)".

The hard-copy envelope must contain: printout of the application form; mark sheets and degrees; proof of age; caste certificate (ST/SC/OBC, in prescribed GoI format); for EWS - Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tahsildar; experience certificate(s); NOC (for those working in Government organisations); two passport-size photographs; and any other relevant documents - all combined into a single PDF and also uploaded via the Google Form.
Candidates who wish to apply for more than one post (different designation or department) must apply separately for each post and pay the application fee separately for each.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Grand Total: 68 posts. 4% of total seats (7 posts: 1 Professor, 1 Additional Professor, 2 Associate Professor, 3 Assistant Professor) are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), on a horizontal basis, identified by physical requirement categories S (Sitting), ST (Standing), W (Walking), MF (Manipulation by Fingers), and RW (Reading & Writing). # Pulmonary Medicine: candidates with D.M./M.D. (Pulmonary Medicine), M.D. (Respiratory Medicine), or M.D. (TB & Chest Diseases) may apply. $ Transfusion Medicine and Blood Bank: candidates with M.D. (Transfusion Medicine) or M.D. (Blood Bank) may apply. * Trauma and Emergency Medicine: candidates with M.Ch. (Trauma Surgery), M.D. (Emergency Medicine), or M.D. (Anaesthesia) may apply.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Based on bio-data, the Search-cum-Selection Committee may shortlist candidates for interview. Candidates called for interview must produce all relevant original documents (self-attested photocopies of Degrees, Certificates, Mark sheets, Age proof, Caste certificates, etc.) along with the printed application for verification. Candidates already working in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Institutions must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of interview. The offer of appointment, when made, will be provisional and subject to verification of educational and personal credentials by the competent authority. The decision of the Executive Director, AIIMS Gorakhpur, is final and binding in all matters relating to this recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a Detailed Advertisement (Advt. No. AIIMS/GKP/RECT/FACULTY/2026-27/239) issued by AIIMS Gorakhpur for recruitment to 68 Group-A Faculty posts - Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor - across 31 departments, on Direct Recruitment, Deputation, or Contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 68 total vacancies: 18 Professor, 8 Additional Professor, 24 Associate Professor, and 18 Assistant Professor posts, with 7 posts reserved for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The closing date for both online application (Google Form) and hard-copy submission by post is 13.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS plus a Postgraduate qualification (MD/MS) in the subject of the post for general specialties, or MBBS plus D.M./M.Ch for super-specialty disciplines, along with the prescribed years of teaching experience for the grade applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 58 years for Professor/Additional Professor and 50 years for Associate Professor/Assistant Professor, as on the closing date, with relaxation of up to 5 years for SC/ST/PwBD and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹2,000 for General/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹500 for SC/ST candidates; it is exempted for PwBD candidates and retired faculty applying on deputation/contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Selection is through shortlisting based on bio-data by a Search-cum-Selection Committee, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level-12 (₹1,01,500–₹1,67,400) for Assistant Professor to Level-14A (₹1,68,900–₹2,20,400) for Professor, as per the 7th CPC, plus usual allowances including NPA where applicable. Contractual retired faculty receive lumpsum remuneration of ₹2,00,000–₹2,20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the application online via the Google Form link (https://forms.gle/LsRQWpksNKC7DxdQ8) with all required scanned documents, and additionally send a signed hard copy with self-attested documents by Speed/Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur, by 13.10.2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts be filled on deputation basis?
faq.answer: No. Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts can only be filled on Direct Recruitment basis; Professor and Additional Professor posts can be filled through Direct Recruitment, Deputation, or Contract basis (for retired faculty).
